recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reintroducing a modified timestamp or rewording the current Provenance notes would go beyond the Published resolution unless Patient Care opens a new issue.
issue_request: FHIR-11346 asked to add a CareTeam.modified element to indicate when a care team was last updated. The Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: remove CarePlan.modified, make no change to CareTeam, and add notes to both CareTeam and CarePlan that Provenance can be used for detailed review information such as who and when.
initial_application: Commit a2b1e7d44e7145eb803af9456a638890b5258d20 includes #11346 in its message, removed CarePlan.modified from the then-authoritative CarePlan spreadsheet and examples, and added matching Provenance notes to CarePlan and CareTeam. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-11346 was present on the combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: CarePlan and CareTeam are active core resources in source/fhir.ini and assigned to Patient Care. The current StructureDefinition sources contain no CarePlan.modified or CareTeam.modified element, while source/careteam/careteam-notes.xml and source/careplan/careplan-notes.xml still include the Provenance review note. FHIR-11346-specific Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting later discussion; a broader Jira search returned only FHIR-11346 plus an unrelated PACIO ADI issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was needed because the current source already preserves both sides of the resolution: no modified element on CareTeam or CarePlan and Provenance guidance on both resource pages.
